Psionics are different in several ways than the magical powers in Magiclysm.  For one, all psionics require stamina to use rather than an external resource such as mana, meaning a full-charged psion is only a short breather away.  Second, psionic powers scale with your intelligence stat and with your Nether Attunement (q.v.) as well as with the power level; this includes their maximum possible level, which is equal to your intelligence times 1.5.  Third, long-duration powers must be concentrated on to be maintained, and negative effects like being injured, being electrocuted, or inhaling toxic smoke can cause you to lose your concentration.  Lose your concentration when you're levitating or maintaining a pyrokinetic shield against fire and you're in for a world of hurt and possibly the character creation screen.
Mind Over Matter: Types of Psionics
There are nine paths of psionics in Mind over Matter, as follows:

1) Biokinesis: Control over physical bodily processes such as respiration, metabolism, skin elasticity, or pain response.  Master biokinetics can be stronger or faster than any human can hope to be, cross short distances in the blink of an eye, turn bolts or pull up nails using only their hands, hold their breath for tens of minutes, and surpass the human pinnacle in every realm of unarmed combat.

2) Clairsentience: Enhanced perception and use of senses beyond the physical and short-term precognition, such as hearing high or low frequencies or seeing through walls or to distant places.  Master clairsentients can predict opponents' movements in combat, account for all possible effects on their ranged weapons to make the perfect shot, have visions of nearby places, and sense danger and those who try to harm them.

3) Electrokinesis: Control over electricity and some electrochemical processes, including the function of neurons and computers.  Master electrokinetics can shock opponents by touch, recharge electronics on their person, stun or shut down robots, paralyze beings with a nervous system, speed up their own neural processes or those of others, and unleash blasts of lightning.

4) Photokinesis: Control over light, radiation, and radio waves.  Master photokinetics can cause the nearby air to glow, create illusions around themselves to hide their position or even disappear, change their appearance, unleash laser blasts, listen to radio broadcasts, and glow as brightly as the noonday sun.

5) Pyrokinesis: Control over heat and fire.  Master pyrokinetics can wear a light t-shirt in a blizzard, light wood with just a thought, unleash blasts of flame on their enemies, surround themselves with a curtain of flame, and heat up a location hot enough to metal steel.

6) Telekinesis: Moving objects without touching them.  Master telekinetics can throw objects or people through the air, walk on water, create a barrier that inhibits fast-moving attacks, carry an object next to them without touching it, fly, or even cause small earthquakes.

7) Telepathy: Perception and manipulation of others' thoughts.  Master telepaths can read minds, influence others' moods to calm them down, tame even normally-untameable animals, stun and damage enemies with mental feedback, erase their perceptions from their targets' minds, and even take control of their enemies and make them fight for the psion.

8) Teleportation: Movement without crossing the intervening distance.  Master teleporters can increase the relative distances around their enemies to slow their movements, reduce the relative distances around themselves to make melee attacks from several meters away, teleport through walls or from the first floor to the roof, walk through walls, travel long distances to places they have previously been, and open temporary rifts into the Nether.

9) Vitakinesis: Control of health and vitality, such as bloodflow, susceptibility to disease, healing speed, and need for sleep.  Master vitakinesis can slow or staunch bloodflow, increase the recovery rate of either a particular location or of their whole body, meditate instead of sleep, purge themselves of toxins or diseases, disrupt the bodily functions of their enemies, and heal grievous wounds in minutes.
You can also choose psychic knacks; see its own help topic for a full explanation.

Unlike learning spells, psionics are not guaranteed.  Each newly-created character has only a chance to gain powers.  This chance is variable per character, set when your character is created, and can range from 50% to as little as 1%.  Furthermore, every path you learn decreases your odds to learn future paths, though it never becomes impossible.  You may take the Latent Psion trait at character creation to ensure that your first attempt to awaken psionic powers is always successful, but this does affect the diminishing returns of attempting to awaken additional paths.  You do not need to take this trait if you start the game with any type of psionic powers; starting psions are assumed to have been latent.
Mind Over Matter: Using Psionic Powers
Psionic powers are located in your supernatural powers menu, categorized by path.  Each psionic power is preceded by a [Ψ].

Powers have a chance to fail based on a number of factors.  The most important by far is your Metaphysics skill vs. the power's Difficulty, and the chance of failure is also reduced by our intelligence and, to a much lesser extent, the power's level.  It is increased by having a high Nether Attunement, by channeling several powers in short succession, and by having lower weariness levels (Moderate or below). Your chance of success is capped based on whether you have the concentration proficiencies or not; only with Concentration (Master) can you reach 100% chance to succeed.

Psionic powers require stamina to fuel them, as well as calories.  The amount of stamina is listed in the supernatural powers screen.  The calorie cost is not, but scales with the Difficulty of the power.  This calorie cost is treated the same as calories burned through exertion in all respects; they can be tracked with an exercise band and their expenditure will make you more weary.  Increasing the level of a particular power will reduce the stamina cost but it will not reduce the calorie cost.

Psychic knacks are another way of starting the game with psionic powers, but in a different way than awakenings.  Awakenings are artificial, induced by matrix crystals or portal storms, but knacks are innate.  Someone with a knack was born with their powers, though they probably didn't fully gain them until later in life.

Psychic knacks are meant to represent the kind of psychics that often show up in horror literature, who are born with a certain set of powers and might get better at them but rarely laterally branch out.  They are meant to represent characters with one or a small number of tricks they can use to their advantage.  In exchange, psychic knacks are one-half the Difficulty that the full psionic power is, making them both easier to use and less subject to Nether Attunement.

Each knack is self contained.  A knack for Chameleoflage allows the psychic to blend into their surroundings, and a knack for Mind Sense allows the psychic to locate nearby minds, and *that's it*.  They are not a full photokinetic or telepath and they will not gain any new powers.  What's more, something about knacks seems to interfere with matrix and portal awakenings.  The more knacks a character has, the harder awakening as a psion will be.  However, if you do awaken, any appropriate knacks are converted over into powers in your path (if applicable) and you become eligible for learning new powers.
Not every path has knacks available, and not every power can be taken as a knack.  Knacks can only be taken during character creation.  If you take a knack, you cannot start as a Latent Psion.
